items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Didn't he teach Omer Simeon? [INTERVIEWEE] Omer.

ctx.x: Would you say there's any thread with those clarinet players, coming from... Say I played you a record of a New Orleans band. Is there any way you could tell who taught that guy? Could you tell Tio had taught him...?

items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: "It was made as a single, with that tune 'Martinique' that the DeParis brothers... They put it on the back of that."

ctx.x: How big a hit was that?

Oh, man, it was a terrific hit. It was sensational. What happened was that the recording company that made it, Lark Records, they sent... It was made as a single, with that tune "Martinique" that the DeParis brothers... They put it on the back of that. Instead of my putting my "Louisiana, Ay-Ai(?)" on the back of that, I made a zillion dollars in royalties on top of "Yellow Dog," you see -- but we put "Martinique" anyway. Both of them was a hit. It started with some... A disk jockey just picked it up, and... He…
